name: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
title: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
summary: AWS Quick is the AI workspace built only for work. Today we're releasing updates that help your team get more done: build and run business-process flows in chat, triage your day in the updated web app, get more complete answers from multiple agents at once, and connect new data sources like Meta ads and Amplitude.
